title: Add pegalink and iotserver24 to the list
author: gggff123

gist.headline: Two more keys to the garden
gist.blurb: The GitHub auth list grew by two friendly names. A tiny gatekeeping chore, completed without alarming the bees.
gist.summary: Added pegalink and iotserver24 to the shared GitHub authorization ID list, enabling their recognized access through the auth flow.
gist.impact: These two GitHub identities can now be matched by the shared authentication allowlist.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a cozy garden gate with two newly labeled seed packets, “pegalink” and “iotserver24,” being added to a friendly access ledger. The gate and a small retro terminal symbolize the shared GitHub authorization list, with flowers and code-plants making the configuration work feel welcoming.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener scarf, carefully placing two seed packets labeled “pegalink” and “iotserver24” beside a warm garden gate and a retro terminal showing an access list; small code-plants and flowers grow around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
